$comment: Van Born Labs MCP tool catalog. Set enabled:true after an actor is public on the Apify Store. Users supply their own APIFY_TOKEN; runs are billed to them (pay-per-event) and Van Born Labs earns the developer share.

actors.title: Merchant Feed Doctor

Finds price, GTIN, title, availability and identifier issues, applies only safe deterministic fixes, and returns a ready-to-upload TSV plus an HTML report. No Google API, no invented GTINs. Van Born Labs. $0.01 per product checked plus a $0.25 start fee, billed to your Apify account.

Van Born Labs. $0.80 per 1,000 videos, billed to your Apify account.

Van Born Labs. $1.00 per 1,000 articles, billed to your Apify account.

Van Born Labs. $0.50 per 1,000 results, billed to your Apify account.
